discussion_comments.comment_body:
By Homebrew's naming convention, a tap repo must be named homebrew-<repo> on disk, but the homebrew- prefix is always stripped when Homebrew refers to the tap. So:

dev/azure-cli → tap dev/azure-cli
dev/homebrew-azure-cli → also normalizes to tap dev/azure-cli
`act-codegen-extensibility-squad` is just a label, but not a team, we should mention a team.
